prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young man in <Picture 1>: a Chinese man about 26 years old with a lean but healthy build, natural short black hair, a clean-shaven face, straight dark eyebrows and fresh, ordinary, approachable features, wearing a plain gray crew-neck T-shirt under an unbuttoned dark blue-gray casual overshirt, black straight-leg trousers and white sneakers. He uses a black smartphone.

summary:
[reference generation] In the nearly empty office at dusk, <Subject 1> picks up his phone beside his open laptop, reads a few work notifications without expression, and puts the phone into his trouser pocket.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, natural short black hair, straight dark eyebrows, lean build, plain gray crew-neck T-shirt and unbuttoned dark blue-gray overshirt are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, soft highlight roll-off and restrained contrast, in cool blue-gray evening tones.
[Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up, seated at his desk in the nearly empty open-plan office at dusk and turned three-quarters toward the left, his face sharp and evenly lit. The silver laptop on the desk in front of him is still open, its screen glowing softly and facing him, away from the camera; a white coffee cup stands to the right of the laptop. Behind him, out of focus, rows of empty desks and the floor-to-ceiling windows show a dark-blue skyline with scattered lit windows. He picks up a black smartphone lying beside the laptop and raises it to chest height, the screen facing him and away from the camera. His eyes move down to the screen and read in short left-to-right movements, his thumb scrolls once, and he blinks once; his face stays neutral and familiar with the routine, without sadness. He presses the side button to lock the phone, glances back at the open laptop for a moment, and slips the phone into the front pocket of his black trousers. Both eyes stay level and symmetrical and look at the same target; he never looks into the lens. The camera holds a static shot. His lips stay closed; he does not speak. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet office ventilation, a soft scroll and lock click from the phone, fabric rustling as the phone slides into his pocket, and a faint chair creak.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
